title: 1956: How Two Hundred Thousand Refugees Changed the West
grammar: Preverbs be- and újra- expressing integration and restarting life (beilleszkedik, beleszokik, újrakezd)
goal: I can describe the 1956 Hungarian refugee wave and the international response to 200,000 asylum seekers.
I can accurately use preverbs be- and újra- to discuss social integration, adaptation, and rebuilding life from scratch.
I can analyze the academic, artistic, and scientific contributions of 1956 Hungarian refugees in Western countries.
